AETIOLOGY OF FALLS
Aetiology
- Multifactorial
Risk Factors
Modifiable, difficult to modify, non-modifiable
Intrinsic
- Age
- Fear of falling
- Hearing impairment
- Medical conditions (e.g. arthritis, dementia, stroke, Parkinson's disease,
etc)
- Muscle weakness
- Orthostatic hypotension
- Pain
- Poor balance
- Urinary incontinence
Extrinsic
- Medications (Anticonvulsants, Antidepressants, Antihypertensives,
Antipsychotics, Benzodiazepines, Diuretics)
- Improper or improper use of assistive devices
- Inappropriate footwear
- Alcohol use
Environmental/Situational
- Clutter
- Haste
- Inadequate lighting
- Lack of non-skid surfaces in bath tubs
- Loose mats/rugs
- Poor housing design/disrepair e.g. uneven steps
- Slippery floors
